name: Monotone Meshing
definition: An efficient alternative to greedy meshing that treats Minecraft-type meshing as standard polygon triangulation. It decomposes the surface polygon into monotone polygons and then triangulates them.
summary: Monotone meshing extracts isosurfaces by decomposing complex voxel contours into monotone sub-polygons via sweep-line processing before triangulating them, robustly handling non-simple polygons with holes.
